verses.text: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large when I was in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

segments.text: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness;
Thou hast set me at large
when I was
in distress:
Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

verses.text: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? How long will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? [Selah

segments.text: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor?
How long
will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? [Selah

verses.text: But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.

segments.text: But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly:
Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.

verses.text: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. [Selah

segments.text: Stand in awe, and sin not:
Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. [Selah

verses.text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in Jehovah.

segments.text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness,
And put your trust in Jehovah.

verses.text: Many there are that say, Who will show us any good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

segments.text: Many there are that say, Who will show us
any
good?
Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

verses.text: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than they have when their grain and their new wine are increased.

segments.text: Thou hast put gladness in my heart,
More than
they have
when their grain and their new wine are increased.

verses.text: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.

segments.text: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep;
For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.
